scope: All completed trials and all attempts retained. Wall time includes organizer, independent review and repairs. Token totals include cached input and evaluator usage; missing usage stays null. Pair differences only for identical inputs/settings with both quality gates passed. Semantic verdicts require independent audit; no general speedup is inferred.

protocol.maintenance_context: fresh context from independent canonical snapshots
limitations: Only two reused synthetic cases; not unseen real-project generalization.
Two concurrent pairs share provider scheduling; this is not an isolated latency laboratory.
One interrupted worker lacks completed usage; total tokens for that trial are null.
No-change write gate is operational, not a scientific-omission verdict; some citation refinements are defensible.
The later write guard is outside the formal comparator; its two checks are post-hoc, not paired speed evidence.
Independent evaluators use separate prompts/directories, not a read-isolating OS security boundary.

evidence_availability.raw_recomputation_scope: Complete original CLI invocation ledger and external clocks not restored. Bounded native response usage is recomputable separately.
evidence_availability.semantic_rereview_scope: Some exact snapshots can be rereviewed; complete original-cohort coverage is not restored.

native_session_recovery.limit: Session counts are not invocation or trial counts. Native session logs are not byte-identical missing CLI stdout streams or external process timing.

joint_exact_object_recovery.limit: Objects span both studies and repeated snapshots; not 114 whole inputs or experiments. Three mixed-newline source objects recovered from native tool raw output, all matching pre-loss SHA256.

evidence_availability.scope: Private durable external recovery only. Original temporary-root disappearance remains observed; no recovered private content uploaded. Original research project not modified.
evidence_availability.legacy_input_limit: Text objects recovered; each synthetic input still lacks one omitted protected binary payload. No complete raw-cohort recomputation claimed.
